title: Yeahlows PVP Pack
description: This PVP pack aims to add all the things you would expect in a PVP pack and more, including less obtrusive shields, smaller items, and more.
body:
This texture pack prioritizes making the most important changes for a pvp pack without making the game look completley different.

The most notable changes in this texture pack are:
- Lower shields
- Smaller items
- Lower fire
- Retextured tools and swords
- Highlighted and shining ores
- See-through hotbar
- Small swords for 1.8.9 version

This pack supports both 1.6.1-1.8.9 for short swords, and 1.21-1.21.10 (Might support older versions). The 1.8.9 version isn't updated very frequently though.
